scope: development-side planning and evidence index; not runtime material

planning_model.unit_of_progress: a bounded Q01-Q04 decision gap with observable evidence, a constrained action or hypothesis, a counterexample, and a stopping rule

decision_packages.selection_rule: A coverage gap may be selected only through one decision package whose status and linked workpack trigger are compatible. A planned package identifies a gap; it does not authorize asset production, runtime behavior, or a provider request.
decision_packages.current_priority: M108 completed the offline-only `revolve-v1` family. Further coverage requires a separately selected, isolated `shell-v1` or `rib-v1` design package; completion does not authorize manifests, runtime behavior, or provider requests.

current_evidence.statement: Self-authored deterministic records cover single outer rectangular profiles, composite rounded-slot cuts in declared +X/+Y frames, nested-rectangle blind-pocket grammars with one and two inner islands, and rectangular base-plus-boss profiles.

known_gap: arcs/splines beyond the fixed rounded-slot construction
arbitrary profile orientation or sketch-frame recovery
dimensions.unlock_condition: A later selected family must isolate one bounded orientation or curve hypothesis without treating the M27 +X/+Y result as arbitrary-frame evidence.

current_evidence.statement: Deterministic self-authored evidence covers base extrusion followed by cylindrical through, blind, and counterbore cuts; M30 additionally reviews a +Z single-cylinder blind/through observable using measured adjacency and planar footprints. Rounded-slot through cuts, blind pockets with one or two inner islands, a rectangular joined boss followed by a blind circular cut, and a uniquely selected boss-top dependent cut remain family-scoped evidence. None establishes generic feature recovery.

known_gap: blind/through outside the frozen +Z single-cylinder prismatic scope
dimensions.unlock_condition: A later selected family must state one bounded feature-semantic hypothesis, counterexample, and stopping rule. Revolve, sweep and loft remain separate families.

current_evidence.statement: Seven self-authored families verify frozen base-to-cut, profile-to-cut, boss-to-blind-cut, unique planar boss-top selector, one- and two-inner-island loop roles, and +X/+Y local-axis dependencies. They do not demonstrate generic face/edge references or sequence recovery from B-Rep.

dimensions.unlock_condition: A later selected family must isolate one bounded downstream dependency; neither face selection, loop roles, nor local axes may be generalized from their frozen grammars.

current_evidence.statement: The prismatic-hole, rounded-slot, multi-contour-pocket, additive-boss-dependent-cut, face-selected-dependent-cut, multi-inner-loop-pocket, and oriented-rounded-slot families have frozen low/nominal/high variants and directional editability mutations. This is family-scoped parameter evidence, not a robustness envelope for arbitrary geometry.

dimensions.unlock_condition: A later, explicitly selected family design identifies one bounded robustness hypothesis, counterexample, and stopping rule.

current_evidence.statement: The active self-authored ladder and the admitted ABC controls supply only single-solid handling evidence. The fixed-box ABC scaffold is a robustness control and is not operation-semantic evidence.

dimensions.unlock_condition: Earlier sketch and dependency evidence is reviewed without gate regression, then a separately selected workpack states a bounded topology hypothesis.

current_evidence.statement: Fusion provides restricted, hash-linked Line3D replay evidence, while ABC provides B-Rep-only input/sandbox robustness evidence. Neither source establishes general native-history compatibility or B-Rep-to-sequence recovery.

dimensions.unlock_condition: Self-authored dependency-family evidence is complete and an external route is explicitly selected after source, license, and representation review.
